item.text:
I can’t verify **current** prices from the official pages in this session: direct page access failed. Since model names and rates may have changed, I don’t want to guess and present stale figures as current.

Official pricing pages:

- [Anthropic API pricing](https://www.anthropic.com/pricing)
- [OpenAI API pricing](https://openai.com/api/pricing/)
- [Google Gemini API pricing](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing)

Google’s rates can vary by model tier and context length, so compare the same tier and context range when checking input and output prices.
